??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Ah, a visitor! Mind the papers, the floor is under there somewhere. What brings you to the **Royal Academy**, *Player*?
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* What is the Academy?
        - *Choice:* You look troubled.
        - *Choice:* How are the downs?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - Bartholomew, Master of the Academy these twenty-one years. I came here at fourteen, a shepherd's boy from the downs, with a letter from my schoolteacher and no idea what an academy was.
    - So I asked every old wizard in the building a question. I have never stopped. Now, what did you come here hoping to find out? No, wait, what did you come here hoping not to?
    - The city's first Magicians founded it. Now we take students from every town on Veligor, and I am proud to say no two of them think alike.
    - The people who built this house once fought a war over whose way of thinking was right. The least we can do is keep every way of thinking under one roof and make them eat lunch together.
    - Troubled? I was thinking about a goat I knew as a boy. Well, no. I was thinking that the roads are worse every season, and that my scholars have noticed.
    - [Morwen](../npcs/morwen.md) reads the old seal-craft, [Theobald](../npcs/theobald.md) and [Mariota](../npcs/mariota.md) read the sky, and [Thomasin](../npcs/thomasin.md) lectures to frightened rooms every week. All of them looking for something they have not yet named.
    - One day someone will come down from the palace and ask this Academy for an answer it does not have. Until then, I mean to keep it asking good questions. Will you help, if I ask?
    - Off you go. And come back with a better question than the one you brought.
    - The downs are still green, and now they have dots on Gervase's map. I prefer the dots to the blank. A blank is a question nobody asked.
